entries.headline: US surveillance, command and transport aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft, nuclear command aircraft and multiple heavy transport aircraft over the continental United States. It also stated that Kuwait had suspended air traffic following the Panama earthquake.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report on USS Arizona disinterment
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Stars and Stripes report that hundreds of USS Arizona families were expected for a 7 December disinterment of unidentified Second World War personnel, crediting @reagan0965.

entries.headline: Damage in Penonomé after reported magnitude-7.6 earthquake
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an OSINTdefender report that footage showed significant building damage in Penonomé, Panama, after a reported magnitude-7.6 earthquake, crediting @reagan0965.

entries.headline: US cargo aircraft, coded broadcasts and Kuwait suspension reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military cargo aircraft airborne, including large transports, coded US Air Force radio broadcasts earlier in the day and suspended air traffic in Kuwait.

entries.headline: Elevated US transport and Baltic military flight activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported unusually active US Air Force transport aircraft over the United States and military flight activity in the Baltic region at nearly three times its stated normal level.

entries.headline: US transport and nuclear command aircraft spike reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an unusual rise in US Air Force transport activity over the United States, including multiple large cargo aircraft and at least one nuclear command aircraft during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: US transports and coded radio traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US military transport aircraft over the continental United States and coded Air Force radio traffic, while stating that it saw no indicators of escalation.

entries.headline: Five coded broadcasts and heavy US transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day and multiple heavy transport aircraft over the United States during the preceding hour, including several large cargo aircraft.

entries.headline: Six US Air Force transports and Kuwait suspension reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, with multiple large cargo aircraft spotted during the preceding hour, and repeated that air traffic had been suspended in Kuwait.

entries.headline: US transports over North Sea and Atlantic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US Air Force transport aircraft over the North Sea and across the Atlantic, along with five coded radio broadcasts heard earlier in the day.

entries.headline: Six US transports over North Sea and US reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including two large cargo aircraft over the North Sea and three over the continental United States.

entries.headline: US transports over North America and North Sea reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military transport aircraft over North America and the North Sea, and repeated a report that air traffic had been suspended in Kuwait amid regional tensions.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 KRC081 on-ground alert at Marton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for New Zealand-registered military P-8 aircraft KRC081 at Marton, New Zealand.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on possible KC-10 transfer
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The Aviationist report that the United States was exploring the transfer of surplus KC-10 Extender tankers to an undisclosed North African partner.

entries.headline: E-2 GRYHK07 airborne alert at Norfolk
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for US military E-2 aircraft GRYHK07 at Norfolk, Virginia.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Suisun
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military aircraft labelled E6 at Suisun, California. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Suisun
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military aircraft labelled E6 at Suisun, California. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on F-16 mission-computer upgrade
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that the US Air Force was seeking next-generation mission computers for older F-16 aircraft.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on F-16 identification-system integration
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The Aviationist report that BAE Systems had received AIMS certification for its AN/APX-127(V)1 identification system, advancing F-16 integration.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on autonomous drone swarms
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Breaking Defense report about decentralized autonomy for battlefield drone swarms.

entries.headline: P-8 on-ground alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for a US military P-8 aircraft at Orange Park, Florida. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 on-ground alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for a US military P-8 aircraft at Orange Park, Florida. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Bellevue
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military aircraft labelled E6 at Bellevue, Nebraska. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: E-2 GRYHK03 on-ground alert at Norfolk
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for US-registered E-2 aircraft GRYHK03 at Norfolk, Virginia.
